threads.text: In Anambra, a landlord cannot rush straight to court once a quit notice ends. The law requires a notice of owner's intention giving at least 7 clear days after expiry. Have you served both statutory notices?
threads.evening: A quit notice ending does not automatically open the courtroom door in Anambra. The 7 days notice of intention must follow.

short.title: Unreturned caution fee? Issue a demand letter.
short.hook_sub: When your landlord ignores your refund calls
short.hook_say: Moved out in peace but your caution fee is suddenly trapped? Calling every morning will not build evidence. A formal demand letter starts the legal countdown.

tips.sub: Demand full written receipts for claimed repairs
tips.say: Do not accept verbal deductions. Your letter should demand written receipts and proof for every single repair the landlord claims against your initial caution deposit.

tips.sub: Specify the precise balance owed to you
tips.say: State the exact naira figure paid on move-in and subtract undisputed repairs. Ambiguity gives room for endless excuses and delay tactics.

tips.sub: Give seven to fourteen days to pay
tips.say: Set a strict deadline of seven to fourteen working days for the refund. This establishes unreasonable delay if you escalate to small claims court.

tips.sub: Send via registered post or signed delivery
tips.say: Deliver the letter by hand with a signed acknowledgment copy, or send via trackable dispatch. That signed acknowledgment is your evidence in court.
